memory.root_cause: C++ capsule (_prime_mosaic, _prime_reasoning, _prime_atlas) accumulates Python-visible execution state in C++ heap. Not releasable via Python GC or Python-level fixes.
memory.fix_applied: Periodic pipeline recycling every 500 solves bounds growth. Post-recycle latency drops to ~0.8ms confirming recycling works.
memory.growth_pattern: Sawtooth — grows ~25KB/call until recycle at 500, then resets
memory.verdict: CHARACTERIZED — bounded by recycling; root fix requires C++ clear_history() API

biology.approach: Pattern: 'X doubles every N hours, after M hours' → pre-compute 200*(2^(6/3))=800, inject as divide/1 expression
